comment: I have spent seven winters counting each barnfly landing with prayer beads – this tidal wave over Port City league was a full-blown miracle? I believe that the water actually sang in the saints' tongues; they must chant before each catch at dawn because every net was swayed like a sea serpent at exactly 3-2 hours or maybe it's the same old witch-who-said-tide-up. Honestly they must bury four tamed mermaids before entering play because no league could handle that storm of a team! So good go Saint...
